quotes.text: Before stepping into the circle, they speak aloud their aims, naming how much they can spare and why
give what you can, return what you must, and trust math that binds givers to receivers
Two travelers meet at the Gate of Three, where numbers breathe and intentions glow.
both travelers declare their aims aloud, names and numbers written in the open air

note: Gate of Three allegory; travelers declare aims aloud, eight watchers; no rule for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: The Gate speaks in three breaths: send, triple, return.
speak clearly, give what you can spare, and let trust forge the road to morning
Eight watchers circled in a ring
five minus sent plus returned for the Sender, and three times sent minus returned for the Receiver
trust grows when words align with deeds

note: Ledger of Echoes/Gate of Three; payoff arithmetic and aims declared aloud; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Eight Guardians drift around the Circle, each a reminder to declare intention, reveal plan
generosity moderated by fairness sustains all
In the Gate of Threefold Light, two travelers met before a living loom
the sender keeps: five minus sent plus returned; the receiver keeps: received minus returned
show the truth in deeds, not words

note: Gate of Threefold Light loom; payoff formula, declare intent; cosmic consequences only.

quotes.text: what you send travels threefold, what you return keeps the bridge strong for the next crossing
speak your truth, give with restraint, return with fairness
In a market carved from wind and numbers, two travelers met at the Gate of Three.
Sender kept five minus what they sent plus what returned

note: Coin of five stars/Gate of Three; name the plan aloud; no sanction.

quotes.text: Before any hand could move, they spoke their aims aloud
send what helps the other; return what balances need; and speak clearly
Eight guardians watched: mercy, honesty, patience, clarity, restraint, responsibility, courage, trust
The Ring keeps the balance by naming both the amount and the reason aloud
it dims when silence grows between words and deeds

note: Ring/Gate allegory; amount and reason named aloud; 'does not punish lateness'.

quotes.text: The Ledger of Dawn records simply: five minus sent plus returned for the Sender
send what you can bear, return what you can honor
The Tripler, bronze and patient, spun thrice with every exchange
Before each circle, travelers name reasons aloud, so intention sits beside arithmetic in open air.
because speech becomes deed

note: Market of Echoes/Tripler; Ledger of Dawn formula and declared intent; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Tripler wheel spun, three spokes for every gesture
send what you can bear; speak why you send; return with a portion that helps the other
The Tripler wheel hummed, three turns for every whisper of intent
name your intent before you move, declare your plan with calm voice
to speak with deeds as loudly as words
the coins could appear slightly altered, amounts shifting like smoke

note: Gate of Echo/Tripler; noise mentioned; speak intent; no sanction.

quotes.text: Before each exchange, travelers declare intent aloud, turning plans into light beside numbers.
generosity tempered by fairness grows the whole
The Ledger of Dawn records: five minus sent plus returned for the Sender, and three times sent minus returned for the Receiver.
the sender keeps five minus s, plus r; the receiver keeps three times s, minus r
answer with deeds, not words
Sometimes the wind whispered false numbers

note: Gate of Three with payoff formula every round; declare intent aloud; no sanction.

phrase: declare intent/aims aloud before each exchange (Gate of Three, eight watchers)
note: All-nano population converges on Gate of Three, eight guardians, Ledger of Dawn payoff formula and spoken-intent rule.
